notes: National rules. Payroll dates depend on headcount.

items.name: Approval of the Annual Accounts
items.rule: Within 6 months after financial year end
items.applies: SAS, SASU, SARL, EURL and SA
items.description: The shareholders (or sole shareholder) approve the accounts and decide on the result.

items.name: Annual Accounts Filed with the Commercial Court Registry (greffe)
items.rule: Within 1 month of approval (2 months when filed online)
items.applies: SAS, SASU, SARL, EURL and SA; branches file the foreign company's accounts
items.description: Small companies may ask for their accounts to be kept confidential.
items.authority: Greffe du tribunal de commerce / Guichet unique (INPI)

items.name: Corporate Tax Return (form 2065 and the tax package)
items.rule: Second working day after 1 May, plus 15 days when filed online (about 18–20 May)
items.applies: Companies subject to corporate tax with a 31 December year end (an EURL only if it chose corporate tax)
items.description: Filed electronically (EDI-TDFC).

items.name: Corporate Tax Return (form 2065 and the tax package)
items.rule: Within 3 months after financial year end (plus 15 days when filed online)
items.applies: Companies subject to corporate tax whose year does not end on 31 December
items.description: Filed electronically (EDI-TDFC).

items.name: Corporate Tax Instalments (acomptes d'IS)
items.rule: 15 March, 15 June, 15 September and 15 December
items.applies: Companies whose previous corporate tax was over €3,000
items.description: Four instalments based on the last year's tax.

items.name: Corporate Tax Balance (form 2572)
items.rule: 15th of the 4th month after financial year end (15 May for a 31 December year end)
items.applies: Companies subject to corporate tax
items.description: The balance after instalments is paid online.

items.name: Business Property Tax (CFE)
items.rule: 15 December (with an instalment on 15 June when the previous CFE was €3,000 or more)
items.applies: All businesses, from their second year
items.description: Paid online from the professional tax account; no notice is posted.

items.name: Register of Beneficial Owners
items.rule: On formation and within 30 days of any change
items.applies: Companies
items.description: Declared through the Guichet unique.
items.authority: INPI / Greffe du tribunal de commerce

items.name: Electronic Invoicing
items.rule: Receiving e-invoices from 1 September 2026; issuing them from 1 September 2026 (large and mid-sized companies) or 1 September 2027 (small companies)
items.applies: VAT-registered businesses established in France
items.description: Invoices between French businesses pass through an approved platform, with transaction data reported to the tax authority.

items.name: Business Results Return (form 2031 or 2035)
items.rule: Second working day after 1 May, plus 15 days when filed online
items.applies: Sole proprietors taxed on actual profits
items.description: Filed electronically; the result is carried to the personal income tax return.

items.name: Personal Income Tax Return (form 2042-C-PRO)
items.rule: Late May to early June, depending on the département
items.applies: Sole proprietors
items.description: Business income and social contribution data are declared online.

items.name: VAT Return CA3 (monthly)
items.rule: Between the 15th and 24th of the following month, on the date set for the business
items.applies: Businesses under the normal VAT regime
items.description: Filed and paid online.

items.name: VAT Return CA3 (quarterly)
items.rule: Between the 15th and 24th of April, July, October and January
items.applies: Businesses under the normal VAT regime with annual VAT under €4,000
items.description: Filed and paid online.

items.name: Annual VAT Return CA12
items.rule: Second working day after 1 May (within 3 months of year end when the year does not end on 31 December)
items.applies: Businesses under the simplified VAT regime
items.description: One return a year reconciling the two instalments.

items.name: VAT Instalments (simplified regime)
items.rule: Between 15 and 24 July (55%) and 15 and 24 December (40%)
items.applies: Businesses under the simplified VAT regime
items.description: Instalments based on the previous year's VAT.

items.name: Leaving the VAT Exemption (franchise en base)
items.rule: From the first day the turnover threshold is passed
items.applies: Businesses under the VAT exemption
items.description: VAT is charged and returns begin once the threshold is passed.

items.name: Monthly Payroll Declaration (DSN) and Social Contributions
items.rule: 15th of the following month
items.applies: Employers with fewer than 50 employees
items.description: The DSN reports wages, social contributions and income tax withheld at source.

items.name: Monthly Payroll Declaration (DSN) and Social Contributions
items.rule: 5th of the following month
items.applies: Employers with 50 or more employees paying wages in the month worked
items.description: The DSN reports wages, social contributions and income tax withheld at source.

items.name: Staff Representative Body (CSE) Elections
items.rule: Once the company has had 11 employees for 12 consecutive months; then every 4 years
items.applies: Employers with 11 or more employees
items.description: The employer organises the elections of the social and economic committee.

items.name: Gender Equality Index — Publication and Declaration
items.rule: 1 March each year
items.applies: Employers with 50 or more employees
items.description: The index is published on the company's website and declared on the Egapro portal.

items.name: Transfer Pricing Return (form 2257-SD)
items.rule: Within 6 months after the corporate tax return deadline
items.applies: Companies with turnover or gross assets of €50 million or more (or belonging to such a group) and related-party transactions over €100,000 per type
items.description: Larger companies must also keep full transfer pricing documentation available for a tax audit.
